entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4313179507891570304 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/v916-aql/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V916 Aql: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3591.9 +/- 204.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 3591.9 +/- 204.6 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2987 +/- 0.0173 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92), 17.3 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -1.611, -5.005 mas/yr. Radial velocity: Gaia DR3 (same row): 15.26 +/- 6.19 km/s.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 90.7 +/- 4.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V916 Aql: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 90.7 +/- 4.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 63,099,990 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 250 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 308, Name='V916 Aql', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 250 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 4313179507891570304: 3 G-band harmonics of a 13.441567384916487 d period, peak-to-peak 1.001 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.04 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,500 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 1.089 +/- 0.064 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffede1. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,500 K and log g 0.52 (u1 0.515, u2 0.194): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 0.52 from 2011AJ....141...53S; the 2 published values span log g 0.52 to 1.44, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.2% of the centre brightness.
